hash_scope: Selected metadata and original selected sample values; not the HDF5 container bytes. Full overview checks I/Q finiteness and hashes both complete arrays in bounded chunks.

views.label: Full acquisition
views.description: Incoherent intensity overview of the native complex acquisition. Approximate flat-ground aspect; terrain, layover and shadow are retained. This is not an orthophoto or a subsurface image.

views.label: Central scene
views.description: A closer view around the supplied scene centre. Surface architecture and terrain are visible; no underground survey has yet been registered.

timing.interpretation: Bandwidth/rate is a nominal local consistency check. Image-row time is not aperture time. A dwell-product frequency-to-time adapter is not yet validated.

spectra.axis: Fourier frequency of full native image rows, scaled by processing PRF; not vibration frequency.
spectra.interpretation: A zero-centered metadata band is a diagnostic reference, not an independently validated aperture window.

translation.interpretation: Known translations of real complex texture. Patches from one crop are dependent; no inferential confidence interval or micromotion claim. The declared 0.02 px tolerance is an engineering check, not a physical sensitivity limit.
